name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based 1-2 frame press and wave release input buffer.

stage.name: Buffer Stage
stage.description:
Buffer strength, in ticks (4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS), as all modes / wave:
1: 2 / 2
2: 4 / 4
3: 8 / 8
4: 16 / 8
5: 24 / 24
6: 32 / 32
7: 48 / 48
8: 54 / 54
9: 60 / 60
10: OFF
